description: Konsesjonsområde fjernvarme Lillestrøm kommune - lokale data is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lillestrøm kommune. Datasettet viser hvilke områder som omfattes av konsesjon for fjernvarme i Lillestrøm kommune. Foreligger for nedlasting som Shape, Esri filgeodatabase og SOSI i UTM sone 32. Coverage: Lillestrøm kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Lillestrøm kommune. Its keywords include Energi, Konsesjonsområde, Local, Lillestrøm kommune, Fjernvarme, Skedsmokorset. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GDB, TXT, SHP. The listing shows 2021-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
